name: Permanent Residency (After 5 Years)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of consecutive legal residency in Sint Maarten.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of consecutive legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must reside on the Dutch side and be registered at the Civil Registry.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' consecutive legal residence

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: consecutive legal residence with no material gaps

sources.title: Ministry of Justice, Government of Sint Maarten -- Immigration and Border Protection Services: 'After 5 years of consecutive legal residency, applicants may pursue permanent residency', Civil Registry registration requirement, Dutch-side-only residence

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Sint Maarten's initial build -- Sint Maarten's PR-equivalent 'settled' status, materially shorter (5 years) than the equivalent routes for its Kingdom siblings Aruba (10 years/120 months) and Curacao (10 years, per that country's build earlier this session) -- flagged as a genuine difference across the three Kingdom constituent countries rather than an inconsistency in this dataset. No fee schedule or further eligibility detail (e.g. good-character, income) was found on the immigration overview page beyond the 5-year figure and the Civil Registry/Dutch-side residence requirement. leads_to_citizenship reflects the Kingdom-level naturalisation route (see sx_naturalisation.json), for which holding a valid residence permit -- which permanent residency certainly satisfies -- for the required period is the operative precondition.
